newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wee Poh offers 25 million shares at S$0.45 in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Wee Poh offers 25 million shares at S$0.45 in IPO.

text.p: Integrated infrastructure specialist Wee Poh Holdings Ltd said on Monday it would offer 24.8 million shares at Singapore $0.45 each in its Initial Public Offer (IPO).
Of the 24.8 million shares, 18.6 would be new shares offered to the public and 6.2 million would be vendor shares which would be placed.
Wee Poh said in its prospectus that about S$7.5 million would be raised from the issue of the new shares.
Approximately S$3 million would be used for the purchase of equipment, S$1.5 million to redevelop existing buildings and the balance for additional working capital for financing of projects.
Trading on a when-issued basis will begin December 2 on the SESDAQ. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
